the shorts, LOADED TO THE MAX ON DETAIL! They've painted on the arm sleeve with 'I'M AWESOME'
the screen printed 'Chick Magnet' shirt looks incredible
The face is dead on accurate, his faux hawk with three lines shaved into the side of his head is there
the included a hat (which fits PERFECTLY) that is also deco'd out!
my only minor complain is the 'I'M' word gets cut off at his wrist
